summary: Frontend-only regression verification of the 'black map after settlement round trip' bug fix in /app/frontend/src/map3d/engine.ts. Reproduced the exact user sequence (map → Città → building card → back → Mappa) three times, plus research/queues/selection-card/marches round trips. In every case the 3D canvas came back rendered — terrain, castle and the 'Casa Demo L3' label visible; luma ~51 and ~1000 unique colours across all 8 screenshots (no black frame anywhere). Interactions still work post-round-trips: zoom-in changed coords from '7,189 · ×30' to a zoomed-in state; center-home restored; drag/pan produced coords '12,189 · ×30' (visible in screenshot); label [data-testid="map-label-stl_0484bd7cfcbd40dd"] remained present. No THREE/WebGL console errors (only benign ReadPixels GPU-stall warnings, filtered per instructions). Bug is FIXED.
action_items: Minor (test-only, not a bug): the coords readout uses testID 'map-camera-coords' — the review-request references 'map-coords-text'. Coord text was still visually verified in every screenshot. Consider aligning testID naming if you want programmatic assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.ts syncDrawingBuffer() is called every frame in loop() and correctly skips rendering when w or h is 0 — this is what fixes the black canvas after the map tab is remounted behind a modal.
resize() early-returns on 0×0, preserving the last valid layout size — good defensive behaviour on Expo web.
loop() aborts before renderer.render when syncDrawingBuffer() returns false, which prevents a stale/uncleared framebuffer from being flushed to the visible canvas.
seed_data_creation: None — used the existing demo@empirelords.com user in world_1 (home settlement stl_0484bd7cfcbd40dd).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The engine sync fix is validated. If future changes touch engine.ts loop(), resize() or syncDrawingBuffer(), re-run the same 3× round-trip test (settlement → building card → back → map) and check that the center 240×240 region of the screenshot has luma > 20 and unique_colors > 100 (a black canvas is <10 luma and <30 unique colours). Screenshots at /app/test_reports/screens/ are the reference.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: on Expo web, opening a modal-like screen (Città/building detail) hides the map tab and expo-gl reduces the GLView's drawing buffer to 0×0. On tab return, expo-gl restores the buffer size, but three.js's WebGLRenderer still had the old size cached, so subsequent renderer.render() calls issued a clear+draw against a mismatched viewport and the visible framebuffer stayed black. Fix (verified): loop() now calls syncDrawingBuffer() each frame — it re-reads gl.drawingBufferWidth/Height, calls renderer.setSize + camera.aspect update when it changes, and skips rendering while width or height is 0. Confirmed rendered across 8 different post-round-trip captures with no black frames.
